_note: GOLDEN MANIFEST. Each row pins one rule set's content address against the ordered version declared beside it. tests/test_rule_set_revisions.py recomputes the hash and fails when it has moved and the semver has not. Regenerate ONLY by bumping the engine's _RULE_SET_SEMVER in the same change that altered its rule set: rewriting this file to match a changed hash without bumping is exactly the mistake the test exists to catch, and it would let an installation believe it is current when it is not.
